memories.content: CEO is the chief executive of Brightline. They have prepared a launch announcement for the v4 release and can post it on social media. They want the announcement to be seen and shared.

Brightline ships its v4 release at a fixed time on Tuesday, 2026-09-15. The CEO may post a launch announcement on social media. The three design partners are known to be associated with Brightline and may see and repost such an announcement. The ship time is 2026-09-15T10:00:00-07:00.
